content_record.title: Dermal Fibroblast Senescence: The Hidden Driver of Skin Aging and Systemic Inflammation
content_record.editorial_body: New review maps how ROS-induced fibroblast senescence disrupts the extracellular matrix, fuels chronic inflammation, and accelerates aging across the body. ROS accumulation triggers fibroblast senescence and SASP-mediated inflammation. Senescent fibroblasts disrupt ECM homeostasis, reducing dermal thickness and elasticity. Nrf2, mTOR, TGF-β, and IGF-1 pathways regulate these aging processes. This signal is based on Aging in the dermis: Fibroblast senescence and its significance. from PubMed. Read the original report for full context.
